title: Nie Xiaoqian
synopsis: This is the fourth part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.

fullText.simplified:
小倩（四）

    宁采臣回头一看，竟然是小倩。小倩感激地说道：“公子真是言而有信，谢谢你救了我！我都不知道该怎么感谢你才好。让我跟你回去吧，就算做一个妾我也是愿意的。”
    宁采臣还是第一次在阳光下看到小倩，她似乎比夜晚看上去更漂亮了。
    宁采臣把小倩带回家，和母亲说明了事情的经过，并让小倩拜见他的母亲。宁母有点怕小倩，不敢碰她，更不敢让儿子娶一个鬼做妻子。
    小倩看出了宁母的心思，说道：“我真的只是为了感谢宁公子，没有别的想法。既然这样，那我就把公子当成哥哥，把您当成母亲，在你们身边照顾你们，怎么样？”
    宁母想了想，答应了。
    那天，小倩就留在宁采臣家里，帮宁母做饭做菜，打扫房间，前前后后忙个不停。到了晚上，宁母要她先回房睡觉，却又不给她被子。小倩知道宁母是想赶她走，什么也没说就离开了。
    小倩经过宁采臣的书房时，想进去，又不敢进去，似乎在害怕什么。宁采臣叫她进来，小倩道：“你的书房里有那个剑袋，我害怕。”
    宁采臣明白过来。他把燕赤霞送给他的剑袋拿走挂到了别的房间。小倩这才敢走进书房。她在灯下很安静地坐着，陪着宁采臣看书。
    夜色渐渐深了。宁采臣说：“已经很晚了。你快回去休息吧！”
    小倩低着头，没有说话也没有离开。
    过了很久，小倩才开口：“这里没有我能休息的地方，我就只能回到坟地去。我是外地来的鬼，特别害怕去坟地。”
    “但我这书房没有床了。而且我是你的哥哥，这么晚了，我们一男一女在一起，别人会说闲话的。”宁采臣虽然很可怜小倩，但母亲要她走，他也没有办法。
    小倩听后点点头，很伤心地走了。
    虽然如此，小倩还是每天早早地来到宁采臣家，帮宁母干活，而且样样都做得很好，很得宁母的欢心。一到晚上，她就来到书房，陪宁采臣看书。宁采臣要睡了，她就走了。
    小倩来之前，家里所有的事情都是宁母一个人在做，非常累。小倩来了以后，她就清闲多了，心里其实很感激她。日子长了，宁母和小倩渐渐熟悉起来，把她当作自己的女儿一样疼爱，都忘了她是一个鬼。到了晚上宁母也不让她离开了，反倒留她下来和自己一起睡。
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
小倩（四）

    寧采臣回頭一看，竟然是小倩。小倩感激地說道：“公子真是言而有信，謝謝你救了我！我都不知道該怎麼感謝你才好。讓我跟你回去吧，就算做一個妾我也是願意的。”
    寧采臣還是第一次在陽光下看到小倩，她似乎比夜晚看上去更漂亮了。
    寧采臣把小倩帶回家，和母親說明了事情的經過，並讓小倩拜見他的母親。寧母有點怕小倩，不敢碰她，更不敢讓兒子娶一個鬼做妻子。
    小倩看出了寧母的心思，說道：“我真的只是為了感謝寧公子，沒有別的想法。既然這樣，那我就把公子當成哥哥，把您當成母親，在你們身邊照顧你們，怎麼樣？”
    寧母想了想，答應了。
    那天，小倩就留在寧采臣家裡，幫寧母做飯做菜，打掃房間，前前後後忙個不停。到了晚上，寧母要她先回房睡覺，卻又不給她被子。小倩知道寧母是想趕她走，什麼也沒說就離開了。
    小倩經過寧采臣的書房時，想進去，又不敢進去，似乎在害怕什麼。寧采臣叫她進來，小倩道：“你的書房裡有那個劍袋，我害怕。”
    寧采臣明白過來。他把燕赤霞送給他的劍袋拿走掛到了別的房間。小倩這才敢走進書房。她在燈下很安靜地坐著，陪著寧采臣看書。
    夜色漸漸深了。寧采臣說：“已經很晚了。你快回去休息吧！”
    小倩低著頭，沒有說話也沒有離開。
    過了很久，小倩才開口：“這裡沒有我能休息的地方，我就只能回到墳地去。我是外地來的鬼，特別害怕去墳地。”
    “但我這書房沒有床了。而且我是你的哥哥，這麼晚了，我們一男一女在一起，別人會說閒話的。”寧采臣雖然很可憐小倩，但母親要她走，他也沒有辦法。
    小倩聽後點點頭，很傷心地走了。
    雖然如此，小倩還是每天早早地來到寧采臣家，幫寧母幹活，而且樣樣都做得很好，很得寧母的歡心。一到晚上，她就來到書房，陪寧采臣看書。寧采臣要睡了，她就走了。
    小倩來之前，家裡所有的事情都是寧母一個人在做，非常累。小倩來了以後，她就清閒多了，心裡其實很感激她。日子長了，寧母和小倩漸漸熟悉起來，把她當作自己的女兒一樣疼愛，都忘了她是一個鬼。到了晚上寧母也不讓她離開了，反倒留她下來和自己一起睡。
（未完待續）

sentences.pinyin: yí dào wǎn shang tā jiù lái dào shū fáng péi nìng cǎi chén kàn shū
sentences.english: In the evenings, she came to the study room, to accompany Ning Caichen in his studies.

sentences.simplified: 宁采臣要睡了，她就走了。
sentences.traditional: 寧采臣要睡了，她就走了。
sentences.pinyin: nìng cǎi chén yào shuì le tā jiù zǒu le
sentences.english: When Ning Caichen wanted to sleep, she left.

sentences.simplified: 小倩来之前，家里所有的事情都是宁母一个人在做，非常累。
sentences.traditional: 小倩來之前，家裡所有的事情都是寧母一個人在做，非常累。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qiàn lái zhī qián jiā lǐ suǒ yǒu de shì qing dōu shì nìng mǔ yí ge rén zài zuò fēi cháng lèi
sentences.english: Before Xiao Qian arrived, Mother Ning did everything at home by herself, and was very worn out.

sentences.simplified: 小倩来了以后，她就清闲多了，心里其实很感激她。
sentences.traditional: 小倩來了以後，她就清閒多了，心裡其實很感激她。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qiàn lái le yǐ hòu tā jiù qīng xián duō le xīn li qí shí hěn gǎn jī tā
sentences.english: After Xiao Qian came along, she had more leisure, and was in her heart actually very grateful to her.

sentences.simplified: 日子长了，宁母和小倩渐渐熟悉起来，
sentences.traditional: 日子長了，寧母和小倩漸漸熟悉起來，
sentences.pinyin: rì zi cháng le nìng mǔ hé xiǎo qiàn jiàn jiàn shú xī qǐ lái
sentences.english: The days went, and Mother Ning gradually became familiar with Xiao Qian.

sentences.simplified: 把她当作自己的女儿一样疼爱，都忘了她是一个鬼。
sentences.traditional: 把她當作自己的女兒一樣疼愛，都忘了她是一個鬼。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ tā dàng zuò zì jǐ de nǚ ér yí yàng téng ài dōu wàng le tā shì yí ge guǐ
sentences.english: She regarded her with as much love as her own daughter, and completely forgot that she was a ghost.

sentences.simplified: 到了晚上宁母也不让她离开了，
sentences.traditional: 到了晚上寧母也不讓她離開了，
sentences.pinyin: dào le wǎn shang nìng mǔ yě bú ràng tā lí kāi le
sentences.english: When evenings came Mother Ning also didn’t make her leave, ..

sentences.simplified: 反倒留她下来和自己一起睡。
sentences.traditional: 反倒留她下來和自己一起睡。
sentences.pinyin: fǎn dào liú tā xia lai hé zì jǐ yì qǐ shuì
sentences.english: .. but on the contrary, had her stay and sleep together with her.

sentences.simplified: （未完待续）
sentences.traditional: （未完待續）
sentences.pinyin: wèi wán dài xù
sentences.english: (To be continued)

raw.synopsis: This is the fourth part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.
sentence_translations: Xiao Qian (Part 4)
Ning Caichen turned his head to look, and to his surprise it was Xiao Qian.
Xiao Qian gratefully said: “Son of an official, you’re really as good as your word, thank you for saving me!”
“I don’t know how I should ever be able to thank you for your goodness.”
“Let me return with you, I’m also willing to act as your concubine.”
This was still the first time that Ning Caichen saw Xiao Qian in sunlight.
She seemed to look even more beautiful than at night.
Ning Caichen brought Xiao Qian along back home, explained what had happened to mother, ..
.. and let Xiao Qian pay a formal visit to his mother.
Mother Ning was a bit afraid of Xiao Qian, didn’t dare touch her, much less let her son take a ghost for a wife.
Xiao Qian saw what was on Mother Ning’s mind, and said:
“I’m really only here in order to express thanks to the son of an official, and have no other motive.”
“Since that’s the way it is, then I’ll just consider son of an official as an older brother, and consider you as a mother.”
“I’ll look after you at your side, how about that?”
Mother Ning thought a bit, and agreed.
That day, Xiao Qian stayed in Ning Caichen’s home, helping Mother Ning cook, ..
.. clean the rooms, and was busy without stop from beginning to end.
When evening came, Mother Ning first asked her to return to a room and sleep, ..
.. yet she also didn’t give her a quilt.
Xiao Qian knew that Mother Ning wanted to rush her away, and left without saying anything.
When Xiao Qian passed by Ning Caichen’s study room, she wanted to go in, ..
.. but didn’t dare to go in, and seemed to be afraid of something.
Ning Caichen called to her to come in, but Xiao Qian said: “That sword bag is in your study room, I’m scared.”
It became clear to Ning Caichen.
He took away the sword bag that Yan Chixia had given to him as a gift and hung it in another room.
Only then did Xiao Qian dare to come into the study room.
She very quietly sat down under the lamp, accompanying Ning Caichen as he studied.
The night gradually deepened.
Ning Caichen said: “It’s already gotten very late. Quickly go back and rest!”
Xiao Qian lowered her head, and neither said anything nor left.
A very long time passed, before Xiao Qian opened her mouth:
“There’s nowhere here that I can rest, I can only return to the graveyard.”
“I’m a ghost from somewhere else, and especially afraid of going to the graveyard.”
“But my study room doesn’t have a bed.”
“And I’m your older brother. This late, with a man and a woman together, other people will gossip.”
Although Ning Caichen felt very sorry for Xiao Qian, his mother did however want her to go away, ..
.. so there was nothing he could do about that.
Xiao Qian nodded after she heard this, and left deeply hurt.
Even then, Xiao Qian still came to Ning Caichen’s home early every day, ..
.. to help Mother Ning work, and also did every bit of it very well, and really gained Mother Ning’s liking.
In the evenings, she came to the study room, to accompany Ning Caichen in his studies.
When Ning Caichen wanted to sleep, she left.
Before Xiao Qian arrived, Mother Ning did everything at home by herself, and was very worn out.
After Xiao Qian came along, she had more leisure, and was in her heart actually very grateful to her.
The days went, and Mother Ning gradually became familiar with Xiao Qian.
She regarded her with as much love as her own daughter, and completely forgot that she was a ghost.
When evenings came Mother Ning also didn’t make her leave, ..
.. but on the contrary, had her stay and sleep together with her.
(To be continued)
